welcome.title: Hi! 👋 I'm your guide
welcome.body: I'll help you set up MarketMate in a few steps. You can skip anytime (top right) and resume later from Settings.

identita.title: Start with yourself 🏪
identita.body: Enter your business name and your name. They'll save automatically.

logistica.title: Your logistics 🚚
logistica.body: Where do you start each day and what vehicle do you use? Used to calculate km and fuel cost.

agenda_setup.title: You're in SETTINGS ⚙️
agenda_setup.body: This is the engine of the app. From here you configure everything: market schedule, suppliers, collaborators, expenses and fuel. Fill the fields from top to bottom. For each market of the week add name, city, km, pitch fee (daily or annual). You can also do this part later: just tap Next.

fornitori_setup.title: Suppliers (still in Settings)
fornitori_setup.body: Scroll the page and find the SUPPLIERS section. Add your regular suppliers (e.g. Bread Andrea, Dairy Rossi) with their products. Everything saves as you type. You can also do it later.

collab_setup.title: Collaborators (still in Settings)
collab_setup.body: COLLABORATORS section: add helper names (e.g. Sara, Paolo). Wages and other details can be added later.

spese_fisse_setup.title: Fixed expenses (still in Settings)
spese_fisse_setup.body: Scroll to ANNUAL EXPENSES: add van insurance, social security, accountant, etc. ⚠️ NOTE: the PITCH FEE goes inside the matching market card (NOT in Agenda — you're always inside Settings, in each market's panel).

home_calendar.title: You're on HOME! 🏠
home_calendar.body: This is your daily working screen. At the top you see the date: use ◀ ▶ arrows to change day, or tap the date for the full calendar.

home_lordo.title: Today's weather ☀️
home_lordo.body: The app preselects the weather based on real forecasts. You can always change it manually by tapping the matching icon (sun, cloud, rain...).

home_incasso.title: How much did you earn today? 💰
home_incasso.body: Enter the GROSS total, then enter ONLY ONE between: CASH amount or CARD amount. The app will calculate the rest automatically.

spese_extra_voci.title: Today's extra expenses 🛒
spese_extra_voci.body: Tap EXPENSES to add every cost of today. From suppliers (you'll see the names from Settings) to any free entry. Examples: coffee €3, breakfast €5, lunch €12, parking €4, tolls €8. For suppliers choose cash or invoice, and split the cost over multiple days if you want.

home_salva.title: Save the day 💾
home_salva.body: When ready, tap SAVE to archive the day. You'll find it in history, charts and statistics. ✏️ You can always go back with the calendar and edit a saved day's data.

stats.title: Your statistics 📊
stats.body: In Statistics you see gross/net charts, top markets, top suppliers, pie charts and many other useful insights.

buongiorno.title: The «Good Morning» AI 🤖
buongiorno.body: Every morning open Good Morning to get the REAL WEATHER of the day and the GAS STATION with the BEST PRICE along your route to the market. Plus: upcoming deadlines, top markets and personalized tips based on YOUR data.

carburante_setup.title: Fuel consumption ⛽
carburante_setup.body: In Settings → FUEL enter NOW an example: last refuel (liters & euros). The app will use this to automatically calculate how much each market costs based on km driven.

notes_setup.title: NOTES section 📝
notes_setup.body: Here you write appointments, orders to suppliers, deadlines, ideas. Add NOW an appointment (e.g. "Accountant Tuesday 10:00"). You'll find it both in the Home calendar and in the 🔔 notifications bell.

backup_info.title: Data backup 💾
backup_info.body: Always export a backup! Go to Settings → DATA BACKUP and tap EXPORT to save a file. Send it via WhatsApp, email or load it later if you change phone.

done.title: 🎉 All set!
done.body: You're ready to start! Remember: you can relaunch this guide anytime from Settings → RESTART GUIDE. Good luck!

home_stats_box.title: Stats box at the bottom 📊
home_stats_box.body: At the bottom of Home there's a panel with GROSS, NET, PROFIT and COSTS of the day, updated live as you type. It's very important to check each day at a glance. Tap PROFIT to see the breakdown.
